lines.en: : Well, I’ll be damned. If it ain’t Captain Fucksalot.
: I’ll take that over Douchebag McDouchefuck.
: Glad you’re conscious again. But if you think I’m gonna apologize for pullin’ you off of Sara-
: I don’t think that at all. In fact, I’m glad you pulled me off. I...wasn’t really myself that night.
I find Yuki alone at the counter after making my way into the bar. And if I focus just on her, I can help myself relive the moments back when this was all a hidden gem.
I tune out the chatter behind me and stare straight ahead, hoping that the person I came here to see will creep into my peripheral vision, but it’s all to no avail.
I know she isn’t coming.
It’s not some paranormal sensation based on an unworldly connection and the fresh knowledge that we’re both prone to snapping from time to time — it’s just a hunch.
A normal, old hunch.
And like a plant, I’ll let it die.
Because I can go one night without progression when there are others who need it more.
: We cool then? No hard feelings from getting choked out?
: No hard feelings. You’re a good friend.
: To you? Or Sara?
: To both of us. You helped in more ways than you know.
: All I did was bust into the living room and knock you out. Ain’t really what I’d call bein’ helpful.
: Well, it was.
: And maybe next time, if all of us are conscious, you can help out in another way.
: Or I can just choke you again.
: Okay...too soon.
: I’ll try again another night...
Meanwhile...
help
: Welp, now that that’s over, Tom Hardy or Leonardo DiCaprio? You have to pick one.
: Leo 100%%. It’s ridiculous that you even have to ask.
: I don’t know. I feel like I might have to go with Tom on this. I like the whole tough guy thing, and he makes the beard work way better than Leo does.
: Plus, watching Leo crawl out of a bear is going to stay with me forever and I don’t want that memory popping back up in bed.
: Also, I wouldn’t have to worry about Tom Hardy just staring into the mirror during sex and that would totally be a Leo thing.
: I’d stare into the mirror too if my name was Leonardo DiCaprio.
: I think we’re a little too old for him now anyway.
: Maybe you, but I’ll be 18 forever.
: I...didn’t like either of them...
: You didn’t like Leo?! I was in love with him when I was your age!
: You were also pregnant when you were her age, so I think we should let Sana make her own decisions here instead of just following in your footsteps.
: What didn’t you like?! Was it the beard? Because Haruka’s right, he looks better without the beard.
: He’s...old. They’re both old...
: Sana, I love you. But you are hurting me right now.
: What even is your type, Sana? I don’t think I’ve ever even heard you talk about boys before.
: Brendan Fraser? Brad Pitt? Johnny Depp? Keanu? Kevin Spacey?
: You might have more luck if you shy away from the 90’s heartthrobs and-
: Kevin Spacey? Really?
: There’s just something about him, you know?
: Not...really?
: Um...I...I don’t really know...
: I haven’t really...thought much about it, but...umm...
: Maybe...
: Pedro...Pascal?...
: Yeah...
: Wait, isn’t he the same age as Leo though?
: I could have sworn I read a thing about late 40’s actors the other day and I’m, like...pretty sure they’re both 48.
: There is no way Pedro Pascal is 48. But there’s also no way Leo is 48, so whatever you read is wrong.
: Like I said, I...haven’t really thought about it...I just...think he’s kind of...cool...
: Should we watch something with him in it next? I still haven’t seen that movie with him and Nicolas Cage.
: What’s that about?
: It’s a movie about Nicolas Cage where Nicolas Cage plays Nicolas Cage. Also, Pedro Pascal is there.
: That is the single most Nicolas Cage movie I have ever heard of.
: I can...stay for one more, but...I have to call Ayane first...
: I forgot to tell her I...didn’t have work tonight, so...she’ll probably be...wondering where I am...
: Okay, but make sure you tell her I love her and that I want her to come by the bar more often.
: Not going to...tell her that...
: Ask her how she feels about Leo! Ayane will have my back! She’ll understand!
: Ayane...only has eyes for...Sensei, so...
: Leo doesn’t count! He’s an exception to every rule!
: Hah...betrayed by my own daughter...
: You want another drink? I’m making one last run to the fridge now since it would be extremely disrespectful to Nicolas Cage if any of us get off the couch during one of his movies.
: I’m fine. Thanks, though.
: You sure? You might need it. This is a Nicolas Cage movie after all.
: I’m okay, Haru-chan.
: Okaaaaay. But don’t say I didn’t warn you.
: So...what’s going on? You never throw together movie night unless you’re feeling down.
: Oh? Since when do you pay attention to anyone other than yourself?
: Since Masahiro died.
: Ugh...poor Maki. I can’t believe all they’d give her is a fucking phone call.
: Yeah...But ever since then, I’ve been trying to be a better friend. Things don’t always have to be about me anymore.
: Because in the grand scheme of things, and this isn’t me bragging or boasting, I don’t have it all that bad.
: You two are the ones struggling, so I’m gonna do what I can to be there for you.
: Thank you, Haru-chan...but just because your problems aren’t the heaviest around doesn’t make them any less real.
: I know how lonely you are. So I’ll always be here if you need me as well.
: Thanks, Sara. So...are we gonna talk about it? Or is this more of an “Ignore it and keep our minds off of stuff night?”
: You know me...which means you know what I’ll pick.
: “Ignore it and keep our minds off of stuff night” it is. Thankfully, we have the world’s most unhinged and weirdly talented actor to help us out with that.
: So...what are you going to do when he gets back to Kumon-mi?
: Nic Cage is coming to Kumon-mi?! Why?! How?
: I’m talking about your husband, Haru-chan...If you want to help me keep my mind off of stuff, let me share what bits of happiness you have.
: Well, I know we won’t be going to see Nicolas Cage.
: Haru-chan...
: I don’t know, Sara.
: It’s been so long at this point that I can barely even remember what he looks like.
: Oh, come on. We both know that’s not true. Plus, I asked about it, so you can say whatever you want and it won’t come across as braggy.
: I’m being serious, though. Like, yeah, I have pictures and everything. And tons and tons of memories.
: But it’s been years. What if he looks different? I know I’ve put on some weight since he left.
: Yeah but you’re lucky because all of your extra calories go right into your boobs and mine just make my thighs jiggle.
: It’s just kind of weird being away from someone for so long and then having them waltz back into your life one day.
: Like, things keep moving while they’re not here. I didn’t hit the pause button on life. I’ve actually done things while he’s been gone. And I’m sure it’s no different for him.
: But, like...what would you do if Sana’s dad just suddenly came back into the picture after all this time away? It would be weird, right?
: Of course. But that’s way different, Haru-chan.
: He walked out on me intentionally...and it’s been over a decade since then.
: For all I know, the guy went and started another family after that. There’s no way it wouldn’t be weird for him to just suddenly reappear.
: You really have no idea where he went?
: You think I would have just sat around and done nothing if I did know where he was? No way. I would have been on that dude for child support even harder than Leo was on that bear earlier.
: Sorry, stupid question...The whole situation is just so bizarre to me.
: That’s because you have a husband who actually loves you and not some douchebag who just pretends to.
: I’m not as smart as you, Haruka. Doesn’t matter if it’s now or all the way back then, there are just stupid things I’ve done that you never would have.
: Maybe if you grew up in my shoes you wouldn’t have wound up as perfect and beautiful as you are today, but even saying that is probably just me trying to make myself feel better.
: It’s all so obvious in hindsight.
: The “not wanting to ever bring me around other people” thing I can understand since I was still in high school and he was a grown man-
: But the constant disappearances...the way he’d stare off into the distance any time I’d try to bring up the future...the look on his face the first time I told him I was-
: The...first time I...told him I was...
: Can you braid my hair?
: Sara...
: Of course...
: Come here.
: Thank you, Haru-chan. I’m sorry for ruining everything again.
: You have nothing to apologize for. I was actually hoping you’d ask.
: Plus, Nicolas Cage gets to see you with braids now. And...remind me, how many men have gotten to see that version of you again?
: Haru-chan, I have made more bad decisions in my life than I am able to count. But even I know better than to let a man see me with braids.
: Good...Then I can keep this part of you all to myself.
: Besides, we both know I’d treat you better than any man ever could in the first place.
: You would. You and me should just get married.
: Not legal in Japan, sweetie.
: I wish the world would accept our love.
: Man, I wonder when the last time I did this was? I hope I remember how.
: Your hair’s just as soft as always. Are you still using that shampoo from-
: I miss my son.
: Can I...
: Talk about him for a little while?...
: Sara...
: S...Sorry...There was...something weird on...
: Hey, baby...
: What...What happened?...
: Nothing, baby...
: But...you're...
: Do you want to help braid my hair?...
When I make it back to my room, I think about her one more time.
It isn’t for long, and it isn’t particularly groundbreaking-
But the thought goes something like this:
I hope she’s with her daughter.
Sara’s affection has increased to [sara_love]!
She still exists when you’re not near her.
